gold.reasoning: 1. Storage disorders (Niemann–Pick disease, Gaucher’s disease, Tangier disease) were considered — “the differential diagnosis of non-neoplastic proliferation of histiocytes…includes…storage disorders such as Niemann-Pick disease, Gaucher’s disease, and Tangier disease.” 2. Histiocytic sarcoma was considered but excluded — “In contrast to HLH, patients with HS present tumoral skin lesions… On the other hand, HLH is characterized by diffuse, rather than localized, histiocytic infiltration.”

notes: Index visit: the emergency presentation with a month of daily high fevers, night sweats, weight loss, anorexia, weakness and recent jaundice (s001); the examination and full workup (s003–s013) belong to this admission.
Icterus is both a fact (f008) and part of the general appearance finding (x006); the palpable spleen and liver edge are examiner findings only.
Serology in s008 is split into a viral panel (HIV, CMV, hepatitis B and C, EBV), syphilis, Schistosoma, toxoplasmosis and autoimmune serology.
